storeDescription:
Star Dum Biryani on Bus Stand Road, Mangalagiri, is a biryani restaurant with tandoori, Andhra and North Indian curries, Indo-Chinese starters, fried rice and noodles, veg and non-veg.

**On the menu**
- Biryanis: chicken (dum, fry, joint, gongura, 65, lollipop, wings, tikka and house specials), mutton, egg, prawns, fish and veg (paneer, mushroom, baby corn), plus family and jumbo packs to share
- Tandoori: tandoori chicken, tikkas, tangdi, malai, reshmi and kalmi kababs, fish tikka; chicken shawarma
- Curries: Andhra chicken fry, roast, curry and gongura, butter chicken, Chettinad, Kolhapuri, Mughlai, mutton curries, keema and rogan josh
- Starters: chicken 65, Manchurian, chilli, 555, majestic, lollipops and wings; paneer, baby corn, mushroom and egg starters; fish and prawns
- Fried rice and noodles, veg and non-veg; rotis and naans

**Good to know**
- Open every day, 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM
- 204 dishes, from ₹25 to ₹1600
- Veg and non-veg; veg dishes are marked

items.name: Biryani Rice
